dboxTimeline.text: Under Bevelle, the third floor down. A stone corridor, and a tall shape at the end of it, waiting.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Rikku
dboxTimeline.text: It is just standing there. Why is it just standing there?

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yuna
dboxTimeline.text: Guarding something, I think.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Paine
dboxTimeline.text: Then we are what it is guarding against.
The shape lifts a hand, and the air begins to fill with colour.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Rikku
dboxTimeline.text: Is it going to cast at all of us at once?

dboxTimeline.speaker: Paine
dboxTimeline.text: Shell first. Then we hurt it.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yuna
dboxTimeline.text: Stay together. We heal as we go.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Rikku
dboxTimeline.text: It hit all of us at once!

dboxTimeline.speaker: Paine
dboxTimeline.text: Shell. Then keep healing.
The tall shape folds into the floor. The pyreflies close every wound.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Rikku
dboxTimeline.text: Free refills! Is there another one?

dboxTimeline.speaker: Paine
dboxTimeline.text: There is always another one.
A second guardian steps out of the dark, and tries every curse it knows.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yuna
dboxTimeline.text: Watch for the dark one. It reaches for lives.
The second guardian breaks. The pyreflies close every wound, and the stair goes down.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Rikku
dboxTimeline.text: Floor seven. It smells of old metal.
A man in the robes of Bevelle waits below, in no hurry at all.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Baralai
dboxTimeline.text: Lady Yuna. I will not hurt you more than I must.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Paine
dboxTimeline.text: He counts every blow. The tenth one brings a drill.
